vendors.name: WhosOff
vendors.provenance: Added 2026-09-09. WhosOff's head of product development asked in July how to be listed here and sent no figures, only the request, so every number below was taken from the vendor's own pricing page rather than from correspondence. Read from https://www.whosoff.com/pricing/ in a headless browser on 2026-09-09; HTTP 200, robots-allowed. THE SHAPE IS UNUSUAL FOR THIS CATEGORY: WhosOff has no plan tiers at all. It is one all-inclusive product, every feature on every account, priced per user per month on a graduated volume ladder with a hard monthly floor, so no single figure describes it and the row would mislead without the ladder in its notes. The recorded $2.40 is what the page itself renders in its own default state — 15 staff, currency selector on USD — rather than a rate computed by us. ONE CLAIM ON THE VENDOR'S OWN PAGE IS REFUTED BY THE SAME PAGE: a collapsed FAQ answer says pricing "starts from £0.95", a figure the calculator above it never produces at any headcount up to its 25,000 maximum; the floor rate is £1.25 at 51+ users and the effective per-user cost never falls below it. The calculator is the published price and is what is recorded. A caution for the next reader: the page's own bundled script carries a stale client-side fallback ladder and a hard-coded FX table (USD=1.3, EUR=1.2, GBP=1) that matches NEITHER what the page renders nor the recorded figures — the live totals come from a server endpoint. Reading the script instead of the rendered page would produce wrong numbers. Compliance is ISO 27001:2022 (certificate 197436, externally audited) and Cyber Essentials, not SOC 2, which is never claimed; UK GDPR data processor with ICO registration. HIPAA is never mentioned, and the security page states the vendor will not sign customers' own agreements or security questionnaires, so both compliance fields stay unstated rather than being read as a refusal of something never offered. Distinctive against the rest of this category: UK-only data residency, with the vendor stating data never leaves the UK.

plans.name: WhosOff
plans.notes: One all-inclusive product, no tiers: leave and absence management, requests, policies and restrictions, overtime and TOIL, payroll reporting and a staff hub on every account. $2.40 is the per-user figure the page renders in its own default state of 15 staff with the currency selector on USD. IT IS NOT A FLAT SEAT RATE: the first 10 users are a $24.40/month floor however few you have — 1, 5 and 10 staff all bill $24.40 — and the marginal rate then steps down, $2.32 for users 11-20, $2.13 for 21-30, $2.01 for 31-40, $1.89 for 41-50 and $1.83 from 51 up, held flat to the calculator's 25,000 maximum. The page's own worked examples: 15 staff $36.00/mo, 50 staff $107.90, 100 staff $199.40, 500 staff $931.40. Sterling and euro cards are published too — a £17.50 or €20.40 floor then £1.65-£1.25 or €1.93-€1.47 by band. Optional document storage is a flat add-on independent of headcount: +$12, +$24 or +$48 a month for 250Mb, 500Mb or 1Gb. No annual term is published; the volume discount is baked into the ladder, not earned by committing for a year. No setup fee and no cancellation charge; billed in arrears by card. Above 25,000 staff nothing is published and the vendor quotes on request.

limits: $24.40/month minimum charge covering the first 10 users — 1, 5 and 10 staff all bill the same
No published price above 25,000 staff; quoted on request
Free trial length is variable, not fixed: the FAQ says at least one month and up to eight weeks, and the live signup offered 47 days on 2026-09-09, so no single number is recorded
The vendor states it will not sign customers' own agreements, contracts or security questionnaires
Teams, Slack and Google Chat are reached through webhooks, not native apps — unlike the native bots several competitors in this category ship

Teams that want one product without tier-gating
Larger headcounts, where the ladder's floor rate applies
